name: recruiter-bff
description: A free job search plugin for job seekers. Paste a job posting and Recruiter BFF tells you if you're a match before you apply: a score from 1 to 5, the key requirements checked against your resume, and a straight answer to apply or skip. Land the interview and RBFF builds your guide from your own background. A story bank keeps your best answers. RBFF also finds fresh roles, tracks your applications, and helps with your resume and LinkedIn. Free, in plain files you own.

interface.shortDescription: For job seekers: find out if you're a match before you apply, then walk in prepared.
interface.longDescription: A free job search plugin for job seekers. Paste a job posting and Recruiter BFF tells you if you're a match before you apply, gaps included, and whether to apply. Land the interview and RBFF builds your guide from your own background. Free, in plain files you own.
